body:
android/gradle.properties carries org.gradle.workers.max=2 and heap caps sized for the original Raspberry
Pi (4 cores, 3.7 GB). They are repo-wide, so every other host pays for them: this 8-core box builds with
two workers. Gradle's precedence puts ~/.gradle/gradle.properties above the project file, so the Pi can
keep its caps there and the repo can stop imposing them. Also org.gradle.caching=true is off: with
several worktrees building the same sources, the build cache lets them reuse each other's task outputs.
Measure the Android stage before and after with --rerun-tasks and record both.
title: Gradle is throttled for the Pi in the repo: lift the caps, enable the build cache
